scope: Disposable synthetic accounts; no external services or real approvals

results.name: The reported Saturday needs no finance review or holiday setup
Automatic holiday rates use official substitute dates and exclude the bank-only holiday
Date and time transitions become itemised lines, not manual holds
Ordinary weekday overnight support and post-holiday early hours use the night category
DST prices actual elapsed hours and rejects nonexistent starts before booking
Worker completion calculates the charge and keeps approval with the participant
Participant approval creates the invoice and attached queued email without an admin run
Double approval and concurrent catch-up runs do not duplicate invoice or email
A queried timesheet is never automatically invoiced
Missing payer data resumes automatically once the profile is corrected
Old finance review expiry and absent manual calendar cannot stop approved invoices
Issued invoice contents are immutable after calendar, profile and rule changes
An itemised correction remains valid when its participant approves the timesheet
NDIA approval automatically prepares distinct time-band lines in the actual claim export
Billing queue and retry endpoints are office-only; disabled email reports queued, never sent
Withdrawal cancels queued demand, preserves the snapshot and holds every line
Repeated withdrawal is idempotent and neither manual nor automatic runs reissue held lines
Withdrawn invoice history and PDF remain scoped, show do not pay and add no amount owing
Releasing a held shift automatically creates a fresh invoice number and separate email
Plan-managed withdrawal goes to the original payer even after profile changes
Partial receipts keep accurate balances and cannot be bypassed by per-shift Mark paid
Overpayment stays in reconciliation and is never labelled paid or silently withdrawn
Withdrawal requires office access and a recorded reason
Legacy per-shift paid markers preserve the partial invoice balance during upgrade
